new.n: Pot-of-gold dig on the Swem farm, Galien (1896)
new.y: Spanish coins found Sep-Oct 1896; dig Oct 1896
new.pl: Swem land, NE part sec 16 and W edge sec 15, T8S R19W (Galien Twp), 1887 Berrien atlas; by the Galien River E of Galien village.
new.st: In October 1896 Galien residents dug for a pot of gold on the D. W. Swen (Swem) farm after Spanish coins turned up there. No find was reported. Seven miles south of the April 1897 Weesaw coin find, and a separate event.
new.t: Private farm; nothing reported found. The Swem parcels on the 1887 plat carry the family name, not D. W., so the exact farm is uncertain.
src: Berrien Springs Era, 7 Oct 1896 p3 and 14 Oct 1896 p1, 'Looking for a Pot of Gold' (Newspapers.com 1063985560)
Atlas of Berrien County, Michigan (1887), Galien Twp plate
pinev: 1887 Berrien atlas, Galien Twp T8S R19W: 'Wm. F. Swem 40' in the NE part of sec 16 and 'W. F. Swem 20' at the W edge of sec 15 by the Galien River. BLM PLSS confirms sec 16 T8S R19W at the pin.
Same surname nine years earlier; D. W. is not on the 1887 plate.
new.tovw: Lead grade C (treasure thread): one local paper

tw-mi-weesaw-spanish-coins-1897.t: A separate 1896 pot-of-gold dig at Galien has its own pin.
